scope: Protected record history and Dashboard C12 readability after apply
implementation: Atlas readOriginalCapture returns the verified durable original projection and reference; readOriginal remains compatible. It preserves current C08 membership/native case binding and exact Request/binding/selector fences.

Dashboard/Planner record history keeps original projection bytes and authority metadata unchanged. Current authorization, source reference and physical incarnation are checked separately and repeatedly through actual producers.

C12 prepare captures actual original records.read projections before mutation, verifies them under the C08 all-surface commit, and binds capture digests into the protected prepared binding recordDigest. The hypothetical command preview is never an original.

The Dashboard receipt reader correlates current authorized case membership, choice, prepared binding, command, case receipt, durable state receipt and its actual C08 transaction proof. It reads current source ACL/physical lineage without admitting another human apply.

Read-only resolution of an already recorded Hot Topic operation requires the exact case/version, draft, operation, protected C12 binding, real receipt and currently authorized fresh/historical source projections. New preparation and application retain the existing live-draft and human-review checks.
Legacy bindings without a sufficient original capture remain unavailable. No old projection, receipt or native evidence is reconstructed.

proof_boundaries: After-apply test uses real product authority, SQLite/C08, Dashboard producers, prepare, human review/apply, BCS, scenario access and case read. Only the initial records and an explicitly conditioned existing choice are fixture data.
record-history.test injects a clearly identified immutable-capture fixture while exercising real source producers and physical source lifecycle. It does not claim a native Atlas run.
atlas-recovery.test retains the real scanner/durable-append/reopen path for readOriginalCapture and its non-aliasing/current-grant checks.

New tests assert receipt/command/proof mismatches, ambiguous changes, membership revocation, missing legacy captures, source replacement and mutated operation selectors. They still require hosted execution.

remaining_findings.owner: WP10 composition; WP03 producer only if a missing replay seam is confirmed
remaining_findings.condition: Stored Planner scenarios with operations still require resolveForecastSource(scenario.baseRef) to be fresh. A protected historical record resolved by BCS alone does not prove that the complete stored Planner case can reopen.
remaining_findings.safe_next_step: Evaluate a focused own-verifier patch that consumes an already authorized original capture plus its currentRef/current ACL and physical continuity. Validate each operation's component IDs and replacement source against that original producer projection. Financial hypothetical/comparison replay must still use an authenticated producer calculation/result receipt and current dependencies; never label an old result as a new current calculation.
remaining_findings.producer_dependency_if_needed: If a replacement or calculation cannot be replayed from the protected original with existing canonical producer APIs, request an explicit WP03 read-only historical source/project/replay seam carrying the original input digest, source incarnation/version and current authorization. Do not substitute current values or relax financial completeness.

remaining_findings.owner: WP11 protected case access + WP14 recall; composed by WP10
remaining_findings.condition: PR36 candidateAccess exists, but ordinary cases.read and Atlas reads intentionally require the original native case ID/incarnation/version. Passing those ordinary readers for another case cannot grant native precedent access.

It must preserve the existing original native binding.
forbidden_substitutes: ordinary cases.read exposed as candidate access

remaining_findings.condition: Hot Topic record reads require the observation-day period. This increment proves same-period after-apply history; it does not claim cross-day Hot Topic historical reads when the current producer rejects the original period.
remaining_findings.required_seam: An explicit producer policy for current reauthorization of a captured past observation period, without changing the original period or falsely labelling current values as the original.
